milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate/observe' task. The player must navigate to the oak plank building and look at the blue concrete blocks on the back interior wall. The target is the center of the blue concrete placement at spawn-relative (5, 0, 9). max_distance=16 allows detection from the doorway or inside the building, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the blue concrete (not just nearby facing away).
